business_summary.text: SKF India Limited is now focused on automotive mobility solutions, providing advanced technologies for electrification, premiumisation and next-generation vehicles after demerging its industrial business.

lab.quote: Now talking about the sustainable margin, we could be looking at 11-12% kind of margin in the near future, while obviously in long term, the focus would be on improving it further, but the sustainable margin will be that.

call_memory.quote: Now talking about the sustainable margin, we could be looking at 11-12% kind of margin in the near future, while obviously in long term, the focus would be on improving it further, but the sustainable margin will be that.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects sustainable PBT margins to be around 11% to 12% in the near future.

lab.quote: So, from '26 to '28, we have around INR 500 crores investment, which will go through each year. This year, '26, will be around INR 200 crores.

call_memory.quote: So, from '26 to '28, we have around INR 500 crores investment, which will go through each year. This year, '26, will be around INR 200 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company plans around INR 500 crores of investment between 2026 and 2028, with around INR 200 crores in financial year 2026-2027.

lab.quote: So, you can say in the financial year '26-'27 is around INR 200 crores.

call_memory.quote: So, you can say in the financial year '26-'27 is around INR 200 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Capex in the financial year 2026-2027 is planned to be around INR 200 crores.

lab.quote: Yes, but you can consider around 6% to 8% CAGR.

call_memory.quote: Yes, but you can consider around 6% to 8% CAGR.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management targets a revenue CAGR of around 6% to 8% looking towards 2028.

lab.quote: The top 5 customers typically represent about close to 50%.

call_memory.quote: The top 5 customers typically represent about close to 50%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Top 5 customers account for close to 50% of sales, led by Bajaj in 2-wheelers, Mahindra in passenger vehicles, and Tata.

lab.quote: Top 10, I would rather say it could be close to about 70%.

call_memory.quote: Top 10, I would rather say it could be close to about 70%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Top 10 customers constitute close to about 70% of revenue.

lab.quote: So, this represents quite a strong portfolio and the order book going up to about 2030, basically.

call_memory.quote: So, this represents quite a strong portfolio and the order book going up to about 2030, basically.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company has an order book going up to about 2030, driven by new launches upcoming into the 2026-2027 financial year.

lab.quote: In terms of mix, original equipment manufacturers accounted for about two-third of our sales, that is about 66%, while distribution sales were about 20%, exports 8% and SKF Industrial share stood at 6%.

call_memory.quote: In terms of mix, original equipment manufacturers accounted for about two-third of our sales, that is about 66%, while distribution sales were about 20%, exports 8% and SKF Industrial share stood at 6%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In terms of sales mix in Q4 FY26, OEMs accounted for about 66%, distribution sales were about 20%, exports 8%, and SKF Industrial share stood at 6%.

lab.quote: From automotive perspective, we have almost more than 90% localized products.

call_memory.quote: From automotive perspective, we have almost more than 90% localized products.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: For the automotive business, products are more than 90% localized in India.

lab.quote: But in 2-wheeler, especially in EV, our share of business is 50% around.

call_memory.quote: But in 2-wheeler, especially in EV, our share of business is 50% around.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company has an EV 2-wheeler share of business of around 50%.

lab.quote: Primarily quarter-on-quarter and annual growth was driven by volumes.

call_memory.quote: Primarily quarter-on-quarter and annual growth was driven by volumes.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In Q4 FY26, sales growth quarter-on-quarter and annually was primarily driven by volumes.

lab.quote: We had 770 basis points drop in our profit before tax, which is about 9% due to previous quarter performance, including certain one-off gains leading to a higher profitability, which includes gain on forex transaction, higher income from fixed deposits and reversal of some employee cost provisions.

call_memory.quote: We had 770 basis points drop in our profit before tax, which is about 9% due to previous quarter performance, including certain one-off gains leading to a higher profitability, which includes gain on forex transaction, higher income from fixed deposits and reversal of some employee cost provisions.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The Q4 drop in profit before tax was impacted by previous quarter Q3 FY26 one-off gains from forex transactions, fixed deposit income, and reversal of employee cost provisions.

lab.quote: Now as far as royalty is concerned, there is no change in any royalty or trademark fees from the earlier settlement. So, it remains the same, how it was pre-demerger.

call_memory.quote: Now as far as royalty is concerned, there is no change in any royalty or trademark fees from the earlier settlement. So, it remains the same, how it was pre-demerger.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Royalty or trademark fees remain unchanged from the pre-demerger settlement.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Gross margins face near-term pressure because raw material price pass-through happens with a lag.

lab.quote: Overall, at group level, automotive is close to 30% of total revenue. In India, it is slightly higher. It is slightly 34%, 35% from revenue point of view.

call_memory.quote: Overall, at group level, automotive is close to 30% of total revenue. In India, it is slightly higher. It is slightly 34%, 35% from revenue point of view.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Automotive represents close to 30% of total revenue at SKF group level, while in India it accounts for slightly higher at 34% to 35%.

lab.quote: two new product lines are coming in our Haridwar this year only.

call_memory.quote: two new product lines are coming in our Haridwar this year only.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Two new product lines are coming to the Haridwar facility during the current year.

lab.quote: At a global level, if you see for any automotive industry, outside India, if you see 8% operating margin is considered to be very good margin for automotive, including OEMs. But in India, we work, of course, our plan is always to remain in double digit.

call_memory.quote: At a global level, if you see for any automotive industry, outside India, if you see 8% operating margin is considered to be very good margin for automotive, including OEMs. But in India, we work, of course, our plan is always to remain in double digit.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: An 8% operating margin is globally considered very good for the automotive industry including OEMs, while the company plans to remain in the double-digit range in India.

lab.quote: While restructuring costs temporarily impacted our profitability, our strong revenue growth, robust demand across automotive and strategic focus on electric mobility and sustainability gives us confidence for the future.

call_memory.quote: While restructuring costs temporarily impacted our profitability, our strong revenue growth, robust demand across automotive and strategic focus on electric mobility and sustainability gives us confidence for the future.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Restructuring costs temporarily impacted profitability during the year.

lab.quote: As we move forward, our priorities are clear margin recovery, sustainable growth and strengthening partnership with customers and stakeholders.

call_memory.quote: As we move forward, our priorities are clear margin recovery, sustainable growth and strengthening partnership with customers and stakeholders.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management's priorities moving forward are clear margin recovery, sustainable growth, and strengthening partnerships.

call_points.text: Management plans around ₹500 Cr capex between 2026 and 2028, with ₹200 Cr planned for FY27.
Sustainable near-term PBT margin guided at 11% to 12% across product segments.
Management expects a revenue CAGR of 6% to 8% through 2028.
OEM sales accounted for 66% of total revenue, distribution 20%, exports 8%, and SKF Industrial 6%.
Top 5 customers constitute nearly 50% of revenue, led by Bajaj in 2W, Mahindra in PV, and Tata across PV/CV.
SKF holds approximately 50% market share in 2-wheeler EV bearings.
Raw material cost pass-through discussions are underway with OEMs with lag pressures expected on near-term gross margins.
Full year cash flow stood at ₹405 Cr, representing a cash conversion ratio of about 85%.
Analysts highlighted reduced transparency, drop in disclosure quality, and lower EBITDA margins post-demerger relative to global peers.

operating_notes.text: Top 5 customers account for ~50% of revenue, while top 10 represent ~70%.
SKF India maintains ~50% market share in 2-wheeler electric vehicle (EV) bearings.
Automotive products are over 90% localized in India.
FY26 consolidated revenue split: ₹3,491 Cr within India and ₹272 Cr outside India.
Contingent liabilities at 31 March 2026 total ₹214 Cr, of which income-tax ₹158 Cr.
Related-party purchases of raw materials and components from SKF GmbH were ₹179 Cr in FY26.
Q1FY27 continuing operations revenue ₹587.79 Cr versus ₹594.54 Cr in Q4FY26, broadly flat QoQ after the demerger.
Q1FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,283.15 Cr included the industrial undertaking, which was demerged effective 1 October 2025 and is shown as discontinued operations.
The resulting company SKF India (Industrial) recognised stamp duty and land transfer premium of ₹1,639.2 million (₹163.9 Cr) on the demerged land parcels.
72,125 shareholders on the 7 August 2026 cut-off; 73 shareholders attended the AGM via VC (1 promoter, 72 public).
SKF India rebranded to SKF Vertevo, focusing on automotive solutions post-demerger
Company developing high-speed EV bearings capable of ~20,000 rpm with future focus on 30,000 rpm technology
Sustainability targets include complete decarbonization of manufacturing sites by 2030
Q1FY27 segment mix: OE 62%, VA 20%, Exports 8%, SKF Industrial 10%.
New PV wheel-end business win with a large passenger vehicle manufacturer, first with this customer, >95% localisation.
All three automotive plants (Bangalore, Haridwar, Pune) achieved >98% renewable energy sourcing and decarbonized status.
OEM mix: 2-wheeler 54%, passenger vehicle 31%, commercial vehicle 15% of OEM sales in Q1FY27
Export sales grew from 6% QoQ to 8% YoY in Q1FY27
All three plants (Bangalore, Haridwar, Pune) achieved >98% renewable energy sourcing and decarbonized status

timeline.summary: SKF India recommended a final dividend of Rs. 40 per share and scheduled its 65th AGM for 14 August 2026.
Ms. Aashi Arora resigned as Interim CFO of SKF India Limited effective May 14, 2026.
SKF India Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹40 per equity share for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
SKF India Limited’s **Mr. Shailesh Kumar Sharma (MD)** and **Mr. Mayank Holani (CFO)** will host Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call on **21 May 2026 at 11:00 AM (IST)**.
SKF India Limited shared the audio link of its Q4 FY 2025-26 Investor Call held on 21st May 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (IST) via its website.
SKF India outlined ₹500 Cr capex plans for FY26-FY28 and guided near-term PBT margins at 11-12% during its Q4FY26 earnings call.
SKF India promoters declared zero encumbrance on their 52.58% shareholding for FY26.

FY26 annual report shows a clean unmodified audit, contingent liabilities down to ₹214 Cr after a BAPA, and AGM resolutions seeking approval for up to ₹2,529 Cr of related-party transactions with SKF India (Industrial).
SKF India reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹587.79 Cr (-54.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹61.92 Cr (-47.6% YoY), the first quarter reflecting the 1 Oct 2025 demerger of the industrial undertaking.
SKF India's 65th AGM on 14 August 2026 passed all eight resolutions, including a ₹40/share FY26 final dividend and material related-party transactions with SKF India (Industrial) and SKF GmbH.
SKF India Ltd’s 65th AGM on 14th August 2026 unanimously approved audited standalone financials for FY2026, with 100% votes in favor (40,613,452/49,437,963 shares).
SKF India rebranded to SKF Vertevo and completed demerger of industrial business, establishing pure-play automotive company
SKF India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹5,878 mn (+27.1% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 17.1%, and announced its first PV wheel-bearing business win with a large passenger vehicle manufacturer.
SKF India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹587.8 Cr (+27% YoY) and EBITDA margin; with management raising revenue growth guidance to ~20% from prior 12%.
SKF India Limited’s **Mayuri Kulkarni** scheduled Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings call for **Thursday, 05 November 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (IST)**.
